statement:
∀ (j : Fin n) (e : Space n ≃ᵐ ((EuclideanSpace ℝ {i : Fin n // i ≠ j}) × ℝ)),
(∀ x : Space n, e x = (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : {i : Fin n // i ≠ j} => x i.val), x j)) →
∀ (f : Space n → ℝ), Differentiable ℝ f →
∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ {i : Fin n // i ≠ j}) (s : ℝ),
HasDerivAt (fun r => f (e.symm (y,r))) (dx f j (e.symm (y,s))) s
proof:
intro j e he f hf y s
have ha := (@yui_aux_0002 n m u q h_H001 h_H002 h_T003 h_T006) j e he y
have hline : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => e.symm (y,r)) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) s := by
  rw [show (fun r : ℝ => e.symm (y,r)) = (fun r => e.symm (y,0) + r • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) from funext ha]
  simpa only [zero_add, one_smul] using (hasDerivAt_const s (e.symm (y,0))).add
    ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))
exact (hf (e.symm (y,s))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hline
